thread:
marco: Quick preflight — we're cutting rc.0 for v0.9.1. I pushed the SBOM to s3://redwood-inference/releases/0.9.1/sbom.json. Can someone sign off on the annotated tag and create a draft GH release with assets? Cutoff is 17:00 PT.

sasha: thanks — which artifacts exactly need to be uploaded? binaries + wheels + sbom + checksums?

marco: binaries, wheels, sbom, checksums, and license bundle. Version bump is in PR #2345 (minor bump).

alicia: I can create the annotated tag and the draft. I will sign if needed and upload assets. Any specific tag message you want in the annotation?

marco: use annotated tag format `v0.9.1-rc.0` and include a short changelog summary + checksum block. Example: `git tag -a v0.9.1-rc.0 -m "v0.9.1-rc.0\nchangelog: fix kv-cache edge case; bump deps"`

alicia: gotcha. Need the checksum file — where's the script to generate it?

raj: run `scripts/release/checksums.sh` on the CI builder (linux-builder-08). I can run it and paste output here if you want.

deploy-bot: Artifact upload started by ci-release (build-58) — uploading release assets to S3.

sasha: small reminder: we prefer GPG-signed tags for production tags. For RC it's okay to be unsigned but annotate that in the draft release if unsigned.

alicia: I can sign with the redwood-release GPG key. Which key identity should I use? redwood-release@redwood.com?

marco: yes, use the redwood-release key (pub key is on the company keyring). If GPG fails on your machine, put a note in the release body that the tag is unsigned and we'll sign from the build box later.

raj: checksum output pasted:
```
sha256  abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890  redwood-linux.tar.gz
sha256  12345fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba98765  redwood-wheel.whl
sha256  deadbeefcafebabefeedfaceb00b1e55cafebabef00dfeedfacecafebabe1234  sbom.json
```

alicia: uploading assets now. Creating draft on GH and attaching binaries + wheel + sbom + checksums. Will sign tag and push.

alicia: draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases (draft created for v0.9.1-rc.0) — assets attached. I created annotated tag locally and signed it, then pushed: `git push origin v0.9.1-rc.0`

marco: awesome — can someone verify that the draft release body contains the changelog snippet and the checksum block? @sasha please take a look.

sasha: checked the draft. Changelog snippet looks good, I made one minor wording tweak and left a comment on the draft body. Also verified assets are attached and checksum lines match.

deploy-bot: release draft created: v0.9.1-rc.0 by alicia (assets uploaded).

marco: thanks all. I'll run a quick smoke test at 16:30 PT. If green, we'll cut the final tag and promote. :rocket:
